motivation.text: Do the plain version today. The polished one can wait until you have something to polish.

discipline.text: Wash one dish. Write one sentence. The day bends toward the person who begins small.

money.text: Patience turns saved money into ownership; hurry turns it into regret.

mindset.text: A wrong turn is still a turn. I can correct the direction without shaming myself.

fact.text: A typical cumulus cloud weighs about as much as a hundred elephants.

books.text: Some things gain from disorder; stress and volatility can make them stronger.
books.credit: Idea from Antifragile by Nassim Nicholas Taleb

stoic.text: Stop debating what a good person looks like. Spend this hour becoming one.
